backupsAdminOnly: Only administrators can create, download, restore, or delete backups.
backupsCreateTimeout: Create snapshot did not finish within {{seconds}}s
backupsEmpty: No backups yet. Snapshots created automatically on version upgrade or manually via the button above will appear here.
backupsHelp: A backup is a full copy of Kandev's database (tasks, sessions, settings). Kandev automatically creates one before every version upgrade so you can roll back if something goes wrong. You can also create one manually before risky operations like factory reset.
backupsRetention_one: Only the latest backup is kept on disk.
backupsRetention_other: Only the latest {{count}} backups are kept on disk.
createUserDescription: Creates an account directly with a password you set. Prefer an invite link when the user should choose their own password.
databaseFactoryResetHelp: Wipes ALL Kandev data: tasks, sessions, settings, repositories, and worktrees. There is no undo. A backup is taken first, but restoring it requires using the Backups page after the reset. Only use this if you want to start over from scratch.
databaseMaintenanceUnavailable: SQLite maintenance actions are unavailable for {{driver}}.
databaseOptimizeHelp: Asks the database to refresh its internal indexes so common queries stay fast. Run it after deleting a lot of data or if the app feels sluggish. Quick and safe - no data is changed.
databasePageDescription: Database driver, size, and available maintenance controls.
dataStoragePageDescription: Database statistics, backups, disk cleanup, and server logs.
databaseVacuumHelp: Reclaims unused space inside the database file. The file can grow over time as you delete tasks or sessions; vacuum compacts it back down. Safe to run anytime - it does not change any data. Use it once in a while if the database size looks large.
databaseWalHelp: Write-Ahead Log. SQLite writes new changes to this companion file first and merges them into the main database over time. A non-zero WAL size is normal - it temporarily grows under load and shrinks back during checkpoints. Running vacuum will reset it.
diskRefreshHelp: Walks every directory inside the data folder and adds up the file sizes. Results are cached for a couple of hours; click to compute fresh numbers right now. Can take a few seconds on large workspaces.
diskUnmeasuredDirs: Some directories could not be measured:
factoryResetCompleteBody: Kandev's data has been wiped. Quit and relaunch the app to start fresh - the running backend still holds connections to the now-empty database and will not rebuild its caches until you restart. The pre-reset snapshot is available on the Backups page if you need to roll back.
factoryResetSnapshot: A snapshot is created automatically under <1>{{path}}</1> before the wipe runs, so you can restore from the Backups page if you change your mind.
factoryResetTypeToConfirm: Type <1>{{token}}</1> to enable the confirm button. After the wipe completes you'll be asked to quit and relaunch Kandev - the backend does not auto-restart.
factoryResetWipes: This wipes the entire kandev install: database, worktrees, repo clones, sessions, tasks, and quick-chat sessions.
featureTogglesLoadError: Feature toggles could not be loaded.
featureTogglesPageDescription: Manage Kandev feature and diagnostic switches.
inviteDescription: Generates a one-time invite link. Leave the email blank to create a link anyone can use to sign up with the selected role; set an email to pin the invite to that address.
inviteReadyDescription: Share this link with the invitee. It is shown only once; copy it now.
ioLoadHelp: Average number of tasks running or waiting for CPU during the last minute. Compare this value with the host's CPU core count.
licensesFilterPlaceholder: Filter by name, license, or ecosystem...
licensesPageDescription: Open-source licenses for every npm and Go dependency shipped with kandev.
licensesStaleWarning: Go license entries were reused from the committed manifest because generation failed. Regenerate licenses when go-licenses is healthy to refresh Go dependency data.
messageQueueAdminOnly: Only administrators can change this setting.
messageQueueAutoMergeDescription: Combines consecutive compatible queued messages from the same source into one turn before delivery.
messageQueueAutoMergeNotice: If a message has a different source or incompatible task, model, mode, metadata, or shared limits, it stays as a separate queued message. This applies only to new admissions and does not change the manual merge control.
messageQueueDescription: Control how many pending messages each session can hold before new work is rejected.
messageQueueEffectiveHelp: The effective value is used for new admissions now. Existing queue entries are not pruned when this value is lowered.
messageQueueConfigurationLocked: The YAML configuration value overrides the saved setting. Change the value in config.yaml and restart Kandev to edit it here again.
messageQueueEnvironmentLocked: {{variable}} overrides the saved setting. Change the environment value and restart Kandev to edit it here again.
messageQueueLimitDescription: This limit applies immediately to newly admitted messages. Lowering it never removes messages already waiting, and accepted delivery retries remain safe.
messageQueueLoadFailed: Message queue settings could not be loaded.
messageQueueMergeDescription: Lets you fold a queued message into the message directly above it before the agent picks them up, combining bursts of related follow-ups into one turn.
messageQueueMergeNotice: Only adjacent messages from the same sender can be merged: your own queued messages merge into each other, and messages queued by another task's agent merge only when they share the same originating task. Workflow, system, and in-flight messages can never be merged. A merge is also rejected if the two messages' combined, deduplicated entity references would exceed 100, the shared per-message limit. Turning this off hides the merge control immediately and does not affect messages already merged.
messageQueueSaveFailed: Failed to save message queue settings.
messageQueueUnlimitedHelp: Set 0 for unlimited. A positive whole number rejects new messages after that many are pending in one session.
messageQueueValidation: Enter a whole number of 0 or greater.
agentRuntimeUnavailableBody: Agent actions and workspace tools may not update while the local runtime is stopped. Your saved data remains safe.
agentRuntimeUnavailableManual: Restart Kandev from your terminal or service manager.
restartManualHint: Restart it from your terminal or service manager when convenient.
restartPendingChanges: Saved toggle changes will apply the next time Kandev starts.
restartPhaseDoneBody: The backend is running again. Reload the page to reconnect with the latest feature toggle state.
restartPhaseErrorBody: The restart could not be completed.
restartPhaseRestartingBody: Kandev is stopping and starting again. This page will detect the new process automatically.
restartPhaseStartingBody: Preparing the local supervisor restart request.
restartSupportedHelp: Restart from this page is available when Kandev is running under a supported local supervisor.
restartTimedOut: Restart is taking longer than expected. Refresh to check the current status.
restartUnsupportedHelp: Automatic restart is not available in deploy previews, unmanaged terminal runs, or launch modes without a restart supervisor.
restoreBody: Restore <1>{{name}}</1> over the current database. After the staged copy is in place you will be asked to quit and relaunch Kandev so the new data is loaded fresh - the backend does not auto-restart.
restoreCompleteBody: <0>{{name}}</0> has been written over the current database. Restart Kandev before you continue. The database pool is closed until the restart. If automatic restart is unavailable, quit and relaunch Kandev manually.
restoreTypeToConfirm: Type <1>{{token}}</1> to enable the confirm button.
restoreWriting: Writing the snapshot over the live database...
selfUpdateHelperFailed: The update helper failed to start. Check the service logs.
selfUpdateInstallingUnknown: Downloading and installing the new version…
selfUpdateKeepOpen: Keep this page open. It will refresh automatically when the update finishes.
selfUpdateRestarting: Restarting Kandev; this can take up to a minute.
selfUpdateStartingUnknown: Starting update to the new version…
selfUpdateTimedOut: Update is taking longer than expected. Refresh to check the current version.
settingsRouteNotPorted: This settings route is handled by the SPA shell, but its dedicated client page is still being ported: <1>{{pathname}}</1>
statusPageDescription: Health checks, disk usage, and version summary.
storageAcknowledgeDedicatedFirst: Acknowledge a dedicated Docker daemon first.
storageActionPending: Wait for the current storage action to finish.
storageActionsDescription: Analyze for a read-only snapshot, or run the enabled cleanup rules when you want to recover space immediately.
storageAdminOnly: Only administrators can change storage settings or run maintenance.
storageAdoptDialogDescription: Kandev will be allowed to rotate and quarantine the existing cache at {{path}}. This path must be absolute and on the same filesystem as Kandev trash.
storageAdoptDialogTitle: Adopt an external Go build cache
storageAdoptionPending: Wait for Go cache adoption to finish.
storageAnalysisDescription: A read-only breakdown of current usage and reclaimable space. Run Analyze occasionally to refresh these estimates; it never deletes or moves anything.
storageBuildCacheKeepHelp: Docker keeps approximately this much build cache when pruning eligible records. A larger value preserves more reusable build layers but reclaims less disk space.
storageBuildCacheUnusedHelp: Only build cache records older than this unused-age threshold are eligible. Increasing it protects recent build layers for longer.
storageBuildCacheUnusedLabel: Build cache must be unused for (hours)
storageBusyForceHint: Running cleanup anyway may disrupt this active work.
storageBusyIntro: Cleanup may disrupt the following work:
storageBusyTitle: Storage cleanup found active Kandev work
storageCheckIntervalHelp: How often Kandev checks whether scheduled maintenance is due. A check that finds Kandev busy is skipped and tried again at the next interval.
storageContainersDescription: Remove stopped, unused containers created and labeled by Kandev.
storageContainersHelp: Only stopped containers labeled as Kandev-managed are considered, and inventory must confirm they are no longer needed. Running containers and unrelated Docker containers are never removed by this option.
storageDedicatedDaemonDescription: Confirm that unrelated workloads do not share this Docker daemon.
storageDedicatedDaemonHelp: Build cache and image ownership cannot be attributed reliably to Kandev. This acknowledgment unlocks daemon-wide cleanup and should only be enabled when the configured Docker daemon is used exclusively by Kandev. Kandev never performs a volume-wide prune.
storageDedicatedDialogDescription: Build-cache and unused-image cleanup affect the entire configured daemon, including resources created outside Kandev. Only acknowledge a daemon dedicated to this installation.
storageDeleteDialogDescription: This cannot be undone. Kandev will permanently remove {{path}}.
storageDescription: Review disk use and reclaim space from Kandev-owned workspaces, caches, and Docker resources whenever your installation needs it.
storageDockerBuildCacheDescription: Remove old build cache while retaining the configured amount.
storageDockerBuildCacheHelp: Uses Docker's age and storage filters to remove old build cache. It does not run docker system prune, does not remove volumes globally, and remains disabled until the dedicated-daemon acknowledgment is confirmed.
storageDockerDescription: Optional daemon-wide cleanup. Enable it only when this Docker daemon is dedicated to Kandev.
storageDockerUnavailable: Docker is unavailable on the configured host.
storageDockerUnavailableNotice: Docker is unavailable; Docker cleanup options cannot run on this host.
storageDockerUnmeasured: Docker usage could not be measured
storageDiskDescription: Current usage of the filesystem containing Kandev storage.
storageDiskUnavailable: Disk capacity is unavailable right now.
storageDiskHighWarning: This filesystem is becoming full (80% or more used).
storageDiskCriticalWarning: This filesystem is critically full (90% or more used).
storageEnableGoCacheFirst: Enable the managed Go cache first.
storageEnterCachePathFirst: Enter an absolute cache path first.
storageExternalGoCacheDescription: Optionally allow Kandev to maintain an existing host cache outside its managed path.
storageExternalGoCacheHelp: Adoption gives Kandev explicit permission to rotate this existing cache. Kandev never cleans a default user cache or another path unless you adopt that exact absolute path and confirm the destructive access.
storageForceClearDescription: This attempts to permanently remove every quarantined item immediately and cannot be undone for entries that succeed. Failed entries may remain visible and retryable.
storageGoCacheBelowLimit: The Go build cache is below its configured size limit.
storageGoCacheMaxHelp: This is a cleanup trigger, not a hard quota. The cache may grow past this size while tasks are active. Maintenance rotates the owned cache into quarantine and recreates an empty cache after the limit is exceeded.
storageGoCacheNotOwned: Only a Kandev-owned Go build cache can be cleaned.
storageGoCacheSectionDescription: Use and trim a Kandev-owned cache for new host-local executions.
storageIdleHelp: Scheduled cleanup starts only after no task, shell command, test, setup, cleanup, or image build has used managed resources for this long. Run now does not wait for this timer, but it still refuses to run while resources are active.
storageManagedGoCacheHelp: When enabled, Kandev gives new local task processes a dedicated Go build cache and may rotate it during maintenance when it exceeds the maximum. Turning this off stops using the managed cache for new executions but does not delete it.
storageNoEligibleEntries: No quarantine entries are eligible yet.
storageOrphanGraceHelp: A workspace must be unused for at least this long before it can be classified as an orphan. Increasing this value keeps old workspaces longer before they enter quarantine.
storageOrphanWorkspacesDescription: Move confirmed orphan workspaces to quarantine.
storageOrphanWorkspacesHelp: Kandev only selects a task workspace after inventory confirms that no active task, environment, session, or protected worktree uses it. The workspace is moved to quarantine first, where it can be restored before permanent deletion.
storagePolicyDescription: Choose what Kandev may reclaim automatically and the safety limits it must follow.
storagePolicyLoadingBlock: Wait for storage settings to finish loading.
storagePurgeEligibleCount_one: This will permanently remove {{count}} eligible item.
storagePurgeEligibleCount_other: This will permanently remove {{count}} eligible items.
storagePurgeProtectedCount_one: {{count}} protected item remains until its retention deadline.
storagePurgeProtectedCount_other: {{count}} protected items remain until their retention deadlines.
storageQuarantineCardDescription: Cleanup moves recoverable data here first instead of deleting it immediately. Restore an item if you still need it, or delete it permanently when you are certain.
storageQuarantineCleanupRunning: A quarantine cleanup is still running.
storageQuarantineHelp: Quarantine is Kandev's recoverable holding area. Orphan task workspaces and rotated Go caches are moved here before deletion. You can restore an item during its retention period; after the deadline, a later maintenance run may permanently delete it.
storageQuarantineMovedAside_one: {{count}} item moved aside for recovery before permanent deletion
storageQuarantineMovedAside_other: {{count}} items moved aside for recovery before permanent deletion
storageQuarantineRetentionHelp: Cleanup first moves orphan workspaces and rotated Go caches into Kandev's trash area instead of deleting them immediately. During this retention period you can restore an item. After the deadline, a later maintenance run may permanently delete it.
storageQuarantineSafetyDescription: Keep recoverable resources for a grace period before permanent deletion.
storageQuarantineScheduleOff: Automatic quarantine cleanup is off. Run maintenance manually or use a quarantine action when you are ready.
storageQuarantineScheduleOn_one: Eligible entries are removed by the first successful maintenance run after their deadline (every {{count}} hour when the idle gate allows it).
storageQuarantineScheduleOn_other: Eligible entries are removed by the first successful maintenance run after their deadline (every {{count}} hours when the idle gate allows it).
storageQuarantineUnmeasured: Quarantine usage could not be measured
storageScheduleDescription: Controls when automatic maintenance is allowed to start. Manual actions remain available when scheduling is off.
storageScheduledMaintenanceDescription: Periodically reclaim disk space using the enabled resource rules.
storageScheduledMaintenanceHelp: When enabled, Kandev checks this policy at the configured interval and starts only after Kandev has been idle for the required period. Turning it off does not disable Analyze or Run now.
storageSectionUnavailable: This storage section could not be loaded
storageTemporaryArtifactsDialogDescripti: Eligible registered artifacts will be moved to quarantine and can be restored during the retention period. Active or recent artifacts are protected.
storageTemporaryArtifactsNoStale: No registered temporary artifacts are older than 24 hours.
storageTemporaryArtifactsUnavailable: Temporary artifact ownership could not be measured
storageUnusedImagesDescription: Remove old images that no container uses.
storageUnusedImagesDetail: Unused by every container and older than the configured age
storageUnusedImagesHelp: Removes an image only when no running or stopped container references it and it is older than the configured age. This is daemon-wide and therefore requires the dedicated-daemon acknowledgment.
storageUnusedImagesHoursHelp: An image must be unused by every container and older than this age before Kandev can remove it. Increasing the value keeps old images available for longer.
storageWorkspacesDescription: Reclaim resources that Kandev can positively identify as no longer in use.
storageWorkspacesDetail: {{reclaimable}} reclaimable after the grace period · {{active}} active
storageWorkspaceDependencies: Remove dependencies from archived or deleted workspaces
storageWorkspaceDependenciesDescription: Opt in to remove dependency folders while keeping the workspace source and recovery metadata.
storageWorkspaceDependenciesHelp: When enabled and saved, Kandev recursively checks only the listed folders inside unprotected Kandev task workspaces that are archived or deleted. It skips missing folders, symlinks, active or protected workspaces, and ambiguous folders such as vendor, target, build, dist, .cache, and .git. Restoring a trimmed workspace may require reinstalling dependencies.
storageDependencyFoldersDescription: These exact directory names are the complete cleanup allowlist.
storageDependencyFoldersHelp: Kandev searches recursively for these directory names. Missing folders are skipped. Kandev never targets the excluded ambiguous names, follows symlinks, or accepts custom paths. Only archived or deleted, unprotected Kandev workspaces are eligible, and dependencies may need to be reinstalled after restore.
storageEnableWorkspaceDependenciesAndSav: Enable and save dependency cleanup before running it.
uiStateHelp: Clears layout and UI preferences saved in your browser (panel sizes, pinned tasks, expanded groups, etc.). Use this if the app looks broken, panels are stuck, or the layout feels wrong. Your tasks, sessions, and server data are not affected - only the per-browser UI state. The page reloads after the reset.
updatesApplyConfirmDesktop: Kandev will install {{version}} and restart the desktop app.
updatesApplyConfirmService: Kandev will update to {{version}}, reinstall the user service, and restart it.
updatesPageDescription: Current vs latest release plus the full kandev changelog.
usersConfirmDisable: Disable {{email}}? They will be signed out everywhere.
usersLastAdminGuard: This deployment must keep at least one active admin.
usersPageDescription: Manage accounts, roles, and invite links for this instance.
